title: Identify the top 3 counties with the highest number of exclusively virtual
question: Identify the top 3 counties with the highest number of exclusively virtual schools (Virtual = 'F') that have an SAT excellence rate above 0.25 and a free meal eligibility rate for students aged 5–17 below 0.4. For each of these counties, list the county name and the count of such schools.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    s.XCL_045 AS county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
  AND (CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036) > 0.25
  AND (f.XCL_025 / f.XCL_024) < 0.4
GROUP BY s.XCL_045
ORDER BY school_count DESC
LIMIT 3
